Green south split is labeled Ashland Branch (Ashland/63rd) and East 63rd Branch (Cottage Grove). Red Line Extension south of 95th/Dan Ryan is dotted under-construction (103rd, 111th, Michigan, 130th) — not D1 open stops. State/Lake prints as temporarily closed. Clark/Lake is the named inner-city transfer on the Loop rectangle. Loop is a region/structure label, not a station. Map prints Library (not Harold Washington Library-State/Van Buren). Metra train icons are transfers, not D1 stops.

City id chicago is a SEPARATE city. Do not invent city=chi, city=cta, city=chicago-l, or city=dc. Do not merge into washington or rotterdam. Agency CTA. Modes v1: CTA ‘L’ rapid transit ONLY. No Metra, no Pace, no South Shore Line, no CTA bus.
City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Cut #1 is Rotterdam only. Washington stays planned and untouched. This pack stays planned. assertCityLive("chicago") must fail.
Timezone America/Chicago HAS DST (CDT/CST). Do not copy Perth / Brisbane no-DST.

Eight printed color lines on the current map: Red, Blue, Brown, Green, Orange, Pink, Purple, Yellow. mapGroup L. Conventional CTA GTFS-style codes Red/Blue/Brn/G/Org/Pink/P/Y recorded as gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown (not extracted from GTFS).

Locked inner-city printed name: Clark/Lake (Blue subway × Brown/Green/Orange/Pink/Purple elevated on the Loop rectangle). The Loop is the structure / region label, not a station and not a hub token. Not State/Lake, not Washington/Wabash, not Lake, not Downtown, not The Loop as a stop.

143 unique passenger ‘L’ stops after shared-transfer dedupe (same physical nest counted once) with same-name different-line places counted separately. State/Lake is included (map prints it; official pages mark temporarily closed for reconstruction into 2029). Green Damen is included (map + greenline.html StopId 150). Red Line Extension 103rd / 111th / Michigan / 130th are under construction — not inserted. Washington is NOT a Red passenger stop on the official Red page (Lake→Monroe); map Washington in the Red subway is the out-of-system transfer annotation to Washington/Wabash / Lake. Blue Washington is a real Blue subway stop.

Map vs page: Library (map) vs Harold Washington Library-State/Van Buren (line pages). Blue Harlem / Western print without the page’s (O'Hare Branch)/(Forest Park Branch) suffix. Merchandise Mart is the printed / page string (not Merch Mart as a lock).

Purple: map dashed = rush period / Purple Line Express. Local is Linden–Howard. Express continues Howard–Wilson–Belmont–Wellington–Diversey–Fullerton–Armitage–Sedgwick–Chicago–Merchandise Mart then clockwise around the Loop (Clark/Lake → State/Lake → Washington/Wabash → Adams/Wabash → Library → LaSalle/Van Buren → Quincy → Washington/Wells) and returns to Linden. Brown circulates the Loop the other way (official brownline.html: Merchandise Mart → Washington/Wells → Quincy → LaSalle/Van Buren → Library → Adams/Wabash → Washington/Wabash → State/Lake → Clark/Lake).
Green two south branches as the map prints: Ashland Branch Halsted–Ashland/63rd; East 63rd Branch King Drive (Harlem-bound boarding only)–Cottage Grove. Split at Garfield.
Yellow is Skokie only: Dempster-Skokie, Oakton-Skokie, Howard. Not a Loop line.

Do not add Metra names (Ogilvie, Union Station Metra, LaSalle St Metra, Millennium Station) as ‘L’ stops. Map ‘L’ stations near those transfers are Quincy, Library, Washington/Wabash, LaSalle/Van Buren.

Feed (Jim D2, not a D1 generator): https://www.transitchicago.com/developers/ Train Tracker API https://www.transitchicago.com/developers/traintracker/ GTFS https://www.transitchicago.com/developers/gtfs/ . Key later (Auckland pattern). D1 stays planned. Do not call the live API with a real key. Never paste a key. The key is not a D1 blocker.

H3: State/Lake closed into 2029 (overlay, station remains in D1 as printed). Red Line Extension under construction (not a D1 stop). Red page mentions select rush trips to/from Ashland/63rd — not a Red station list row.

Hub lock. Blue subway under the Loop rectangle. Harlem and Western print twice on this line (O'Hare Branch vs Forest Park Branch) — same string, two places. Map does not append the page’s branch suffix.
Blue Washington is a real subway stop. Not Red Washington (absent). Not Washington/Wabash. Not Washington/Wells.

Brown and Purple Express enter the Loop here. Brown circulates the other way from Orange/Pink/Purple (official brownline.html order Washington/Wells→Quincy→LaSalle/Van Buren→Library→Adams/Wabash→Washington/Wabash→State/Lake→Clark/Lake).
Loop is circulation, not a Brown terminus. Direction token is Brown + Kimball.

branches.note: Green Damen is on this map and on greenline.html (StopId 150) between California and Ashland. Distinct from Blue Damen, Brown Damen, Pink Damen.
Shared Green/Pink Lake Street elevated. Not Orange Ashland. Not Ashland/63rd.

Green crosses the north/east Loop only (Clark/Lake, State/Lake, Washington/Wabash, Adams/Wabash) then leaves south to Roosevelt. Does not serve Library / LaSalle/Van Buren / Quincy / Washington/Wells.
South split. Ashland Branch: Halsted, Ashland/63rd (listed next in stations[]). East 63rd Branch: King Drive (Harlem-bound boarding only), Cottage Grove (listed after Ashland/63rd).

Orange circulates the Loop (official orangeline.html: Library→LaSalle/Van Buren→Quincy→Washington/Wells→Clark/Lake→State/Lake→Washington/Wabash→Adams/Wabash) then returns to Midway. Loop is not an Orange terminus. Direction token is Orange + Midway.
Pink circulates the Loop clockwise with Purple Express (Clark/Lake→…→Washington/Wells) then returns west. Loop is not a Pink terminus. Direction token is Pink + 54th/Cermak.
